name: luh-nanosecond-pulsed-laser-ablation-as-a-universal-method-for-oxide-removal
notes:
This dataset contains all relevant files for the publication: "Nanosecond-Pulsed Laser Ablation as a Universal  Method for Oxide Removal and Surface Structuring of Aluminum and Copper for Advanced Manufacturing Applications"

# Dataset description
The Data is available in the original processing formats.

## CLSM - Roughness measurements
- CLSM-Data of aluminum and copper samples in .vk6-Format  
- Exported Pictures  
- Excel-Files of exported roughness values (Sa, Sq, Sz, Sp, Sv, Sal, Sdq, Sdr, Std, Str, Spd, Spc)
- Python-Scripts for Plotting

## Nanoindentation
- Excel-Files of Nanoindentation measurements
- Python-Script for Plotting

## XRD
- Residual Stresses: Raw-Data from XRD-Measurements on aluminum and copper samples
- Texture: Raw-Data from XRD-Measurements on aluminum and copper samples
- Python-Script for Plotting

## XPS
- Raw-Data and Plots of XPS measurements of aluminum and copper samples

## Data from the Section 'Applications in Manufacturing'
Data used to generate plots in the application-section of the paper with the following manufacturing processes:  

* Adhesive bonding  
- Cold roll bonding  
- Compound casting  
- Laser beam brazing
